derivation:
by
  dsimp only
  simpa only [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, ← CommRingCat.hom_comp, Scheme.Hom.appLE] using congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom (f.map_appLE hV.le (homOfLE (show U ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op).symm
explanation: Specialize map_appLE to restriction from the top open to U. Unfolding appLE and expressing categorical composition as ring-hom composition gives the stated square; only hV.le is needed. The candidate is independent of the target theorem.
